# awesome-private-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that protect data sovereignty through architecture, categorized by privacy levels from on-device to hosted.

The project is a maintained list of architectures and vendors, not a software library. It organizes tools into four privacy levels and includes sections for open-weights models and auditing tools. Each entry specifies data flow, telemetry defaults, and how to disable network activity.

## Docs

- [awesome-private-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/main/README.md): Curated list of AI tools prioritizing data sovereignty through architectural privacy rather than policy promises.
- [Why this list exists — and how it differs from awesome-local-ai](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists--and-how-it-differs-from-awesome-local-ai): Distinction between local and private tools, plus the four-tier privacy ladder used to categorize entries.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Symbol key explaining icons for hosting type, source availability, audit status, pricing, and region.
- [Level 1 — On Your Device](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-1--on-your-device): Catalog of on-device AI tools where data never leaves the user's local machine.
- [Level 2 — On Your Server](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-2--on-your-server): Self-hosted AI tools running on user-controlled servers, with notes on default telemetry settings.
- [Level 3 — Can't See, Provably](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-3--cant-see-provably): Hosted AI services using cryptography or hardware enclaves to provably prevent operator data access.
- [Level 4 — Processes, Never Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#level-4--processes-never-stores): Services with no-retention commitments, local or user-keyed storage, and verifiable data flows.
- [Open-Weights Models You Can Audit](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#open-weights-models-you-can-audit): Open-weights models with licenses permitting local execution, offline inference, and code auditing.
- [Privacy Auditing Tools](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#privacy-auditing-tools): Tools for static analysis, network interception, and firewalling to verify vendor privacy claims.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-private-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related lists covering local AI, license analysis, Linux distros, and MCP servers.
